sources.snippet: An AI that learned to play (and bluff at) Argentine truco by playing against itself. Runs entirely in your browser. It learned to bluff: it calls envido with 7 points or less in 38 % of those hands, and 17 % of its truco calls come with a hand in the weakest 30 % (the heuristic: 0 %). The Haiku ...

sources.title: KeshavVarad/TruckAgent: 2-player Truco AI: tabular CFR - GitHub
sources.snippet: A 2-player Truco AI built bottom-up. Walks the full ladder from a hand-rolled game engine through tabular Counterfactual Regret Minimization (CFR), a parallel Rust port, and finally a Deep CFR neural-network variant with match-value optimization and exploit tracking.
